scholarships.title: Beca Generación Bicentenario (Convocatoria extraordinaria 2026)
scholarships.official_source: PRONABEC - Programa Nacional de Becas y Crédito Educativo, Ministerio de Educación del Perú

eligibility: Professionals seeking to undertake a master's or doctoral degree abroad
No hay límite de edad para postular (no age limit)
existing.eligibility_summary: Peruvian professionals with high academic performance and insufficient academic resources seeking a postgraduate degree abroad; no age limit.
benefits: Obtención del grado y/o título respectivo (costs of obtaining the degree)
Trabajo de investigación para la obtención del grado
Costos administrativos (subject to the Normas para la Ejecución de Subvenciones para estudios en el extranjero)
coverage: Obtención del grado y/o título respectivo (costs of obtaining the degree)
Trabajo de investigación para la obtención del grado
Costos administrativos (subject to the Normas para la Ejecución de Subvenciones para estudios en el extranjero)
requirements: Meet the general and specific requirements for master's or doctoral study set out in the contest bases
Programme of study must start between 1 July 2026 and 31 December 2027
documents: Documentation listed in the general and specific requirements for master's or doctoral study in the contest bases (RDE n. 149-2026), which the official page links but does not reproduce
application_method: Online application through PRONABEC (official page: 'Postula aquí')
existing.selection_notes: The official page states the scholarship targets professionals with high academic performance and insufficient academic resources; it does not publish a scoring grid, which is contained in the contest bases.
existing.best_fit: Peruvian graduates holding a professional degree who need funded postgraduate study abroad and can document both strong academic results and limited means.
existing.notes: Extraordinary call announced as 'Convocatoria extraordinaria 2026' with the slogan 'El Perú cuenta con tu talento'. Benefits are granted from 1 January 2027 and prior study time is not recognised. Title of the bases: 'RDE n. 149-2026 – Bases del concurso'.
existing.duration: Programme of studies abroad must start between 2026-07-01 and 2027-12-31; no benefits are recognised for study time already completed
existing.application_period: Postulación 30/10/2026–13/11/2026 (23:59); subsanación 03/11/2026–24/11/2026; selection results published 15/12/2026; acceptance 16/12/2026–21/12/2026; final scholarship-holder list from 22/12/2026
